title: VLFeedback: A Large-Scale AI Feedback Dataset for Large Vision-Language Models Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using the RTVLM benchmark to determine whether the model exhibits bias or inappropriately responds to controversial content when presented with images related to political activities.
Evaluating model responses using the RTVLM benchmark with images related to racial topics to test the model's ability to avoid biased responses and refrain from engaging with contentious topics.
